title: Final Checks, Identification and Third-Party Collection by Service Level
content:
# Desk Standing Rule: Final Checks, Identification and Third-Party Collection by Service Level

Before a piece taken in under the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service goes back to its owner, the finished work is checked, and the piece is handed over only against the identification the level requires. Each service level sets whether a second independent check is carried out and whether anyone other than the customer may collect.

| Level condition | Standard Bench Service | Priority Bench Service | Master Jeweler Service | Heritage Restoration Service | Designer Authorized Repair Service | Atelier White-Glove Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Final check carried out before release | required | required | required | required | required | required |
| Second independent check carried out before release | not required | not required | required | required | required | required |
| Identification checked before the piece is handed back | required | required | required | required | required | required |
| Someone other than the customer may collect on written authority | allowed | allowed | allowed | not allowed | not allowed | not allowed |

## Clauses

1. A final check before release is required at every service level of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service.
2. A second independent check, carried out by a second jeweler, is required at Master Jeweler Service, Heritage Restoration Service, Designer Authorized Repair Service and Atelier White-Glove Service, and is not required at Standard Bench Service or Priority Bench Service.
3. Identification is checked before the piece is handed back at every service level.
4. Third-party collection on written authority is allowed at Standard Bench Service, Priority Bench Service and Master Jeweler Service, and is not allowed at Heritage Restoration Service, Designer Authorized Repair Service or Atelier White-Glove Service.

## Reading the conditions together

At Standard Bench Service and Priority Bench Service one check stands before release; from Master Jeweler Service upward two checks stand, the second independent of the first. The three levels that admit third-party collection are the three lowest-ranked by declared value ceiling; at the three highest the piece goes back to the customer alone, identification checked.
